row.title: Unlearn phased rollout to all three audiences
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-21: all three audiences, phased. Phase 1 coaches and parents (no child data), phase 2 Agora-style schools (school is controller), phase 3 kids directly behind consent, DPIA, retention, security and controller-entity gates. Coach before build; measure learning that holds without the AI.
